column3: MT 80:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces and transliterates the preposition as “El Shoshannim; Eduth.” Close to the Hebrew; “who sit on the cherubim” is rendered “who are enthroned above the cherubim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will You smoke” is rendered “will You be angry.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a third (measure)” is rendered “in large measure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a contention” is rendered “an object of contention.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You uprooted” is rendered “You removed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “its walls” is rendered “its hedges,” and NASB supplies “fruit.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB renders “please” as “we beseech You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You will revive us” is rendered as an imperative.
